page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Main text in one column of full lines with marginal notes in the left margin (line numbers 3440, 3441 and similar) and in the right margin (side notes in small italic type). Text runs top to bottom.

main_text.p: A THENIS Hipparchus turpi in quendam, Paulan. in Lisandro. Hermodoro ... (copied below)

A THENIS Hipparchus turpi in quendam Hermodorum affectu exstirpans, & repulsam Lysandrum Hippias; bis pallium tandem conceptum in Inrorem, 3436 confunderet, ab Hermeo & Aristogitone occi- sus est. Ejus mortem, dum vindicare iudet, Hippias, à Lacedaemoniis (quibus arcessitus ab Alcmaeonidis pecunia corrupti, ut ibi averent 3440 Athenas perlustrarent) oppugnare, Attica exce- dere cogitur. Pelia Hippo, veteris tedio ... agitati Athenienses, tandem ex quatuor tribubus Thucyd. v. Plut. 34. decem effecerunt, & primum sanguinem in Ti reti..., 3441 cap. 4. in Persicorum... Religionem...
Apud MACEDONAS excepit Perficos Lepidos Amyntae: Alexander vero ... ut ... t tuccessit ... ... ...

page.notes: Page is a heavily worn scan; many words in the main text and margins are illegible or doubtful. Marginal notes on both sides are only partly readable. Lines marked with ellipses are not reliably transcribed. Page number 213 is printed top right. Several lines near the foot are partly obscured; the signature "O 3" appears at the bottom.
